setup_intro: Create the first household and its administrator. The other households and people can be added afterwards.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error_no_rule: This category has no split for that date. Ask an administrator to add one.
error_period_closed: That period has been reconciled and closed, so its bills cannot change.
error_last_admin: The app needs at least one active administrator.
error_rule_in_use: This rule has split bills already, so it cannot be deleted.
error_rule_exists_on_date: This category already has a rule starting on that date.
error_unsupported_file: Only PDF files and photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) can be attached.
error_too_large: That file is too large. Try a smaller PDF or a lower-resolution photo.
error_overlaps_closed_period: That period overlaps one already reconciled and closed.
error_already_set_up: The app has already been set up.
error_offline: The server cannot be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error_amount: Enter an amount in euros, such as 12.50.
error_shares_total: The shares must add up to 100%.
bills_empty: No bills yet. Upload one, or add it by hand with New bill.
confirm_delete_bill: Delete this bill? It stays in the activity log.
files_add: Attach a PDF or a photo
files_after_save: Files can be attached once the bill is saved.
settlements_empty: No transfers recorded yet. The Balances page shows who should pay whom.
confirm_delete_settlement: Delete this transfer? It stays in the activity log.
field_reset_password: New password (leave blank to keep the current one)
category_no_rule: No rule yet: bills cannot use this category.
field_rule_note: Note (for example, where it was agreed)
rule_hint: Bills already split keep their split. A rule is never edited: add a new one from a later date.
setting_reconciliation_hint: At the end of a period, split its bills again by the shares agreed then, and settle the difference.
reconciliation_shares_hint: Leave a category empty to keep its split.
confirm_close_reconciliation: Close this reconciliation? The adjustments become part of the balances and the period's bills are locked. This cannot be undone.
password_changed: Password changed. Other browsers have been logged out.
login_passkey: Log in with fingerprint or face
passkeys_intro: Log in with this device's fingerprint, face recognition or screen lock instead of your password. A passkey is saved on the device for this.
passkey_added: Passkey added. Next time, log in with it.
confirm_remove_passkey: Remove this passkey? It will no longer log you in.
error_passkey_rejected: The passkey could not be verified. Try again, or use your password.
error_passkey_unknown: This passkey is not linked to any account. Log in with your password.
error_passkey_expired: That took too long. Try again.
error_passkey_exists: That passkey is already on your account.
services_intro: What the house has with each supplier, and what its contract says: references, when it ends or renews, the minimum term and the notice needed to leave.
suppliers_empty: No suppliers yet. Add the companies that bill the house.
field_identifiers: References, one per line (e.g. CPE: PT0002…)
documents_search_placeholder: Words in the title or the text
documents_empty: No documents yet. Add contracts, terms and the signed agreement here.
document_no_text: No text found in this file to search by.
error_supplier_exists: A supplier with that name or NIF already exists.
read_banner: Read from {file}. Check every field before saving.
read_vouched: The date, the invoice number and the total come from the bill's QR code.
read_ocr: Some of it was read from a scan, so check the amounts carefully.
read_total_mismatch: The total printed on the page differs from the one in the QR code; the QR code's is used.
read_lines_dropped: The bill's items did not add up to its total, so they were left out. Add them by hand.
read_unknown_supplier: The supplier with NIF {nif} is not on file yet. Enter its name above, and saving adds it to your suppliers.
read_duplicate: This bill may already have been entered.
error_read_timeout: Reading the file took too long. Enter the bill by hand.
error_unreadable: That file could not be read. Enter the bill by hand.
notify_missing_bill: Regular bills that have not arrived
notify_test_sent: Test sent. Check your email or Signal.
notify_test_failed: The test could not be delivered. Check the address and the number.
read_claude: Claude read some of it, since the app does not know this bill's layout. Check those fields against the file.
read_claude_failed: Claude could not read this bill, so only what the app read itself is filled in.
error_claude_off: Claude is not set up for this app.
error_claude_failed: Claude could not be reached. Try again later.
error_claude_declined: Claude did not answer this one.
study_question_placeholder: How long is the minimum term?
study_check: Claude can be wrong. Check what matters against the document.
terms_no_service: Link this document to a service to update it with these.
notify_intro: Get a message by email or Signal when something needs your attention.
field_phone_hint: Use a number registered on Signal. One without a country code is taken as +{code}.
error_no_contact: Add an email address or a phone number first.
error_invalid_email: That is not an email address.
error_invalid_phone: That is not a phone number.
confirm_deactivate_household: Deactivate {name}? Its history is kept, and it can be reactivated later.
confirm_deactivate_category: Deactivate {name}? New bills can no longer use it; bills already entered keep it.
file_attach_failed: The bill was saved, but its file could not be attached. Attach it again below.
passkey_offer: Log in faster next time with your fingerprint or face?
passkey_offer_done: All set. Next time you can log in with your fingerprint or face.
setting_site_title_hint: Shown in the menu, in the browser tab and on a phone's home screen. Leave blank to use ‘{name}’.
setup_from_bill_failed: The bill was saved, but its supplier or service could not be added. Add them under Services.
